episodes.173233: Isolated to scattered showers and thunderstorms continued to impact NM as a persistent upper-level low pressure system drifted over the region. Just enough instability and shear below the larger scale rotation aloft allowed a storm near Belen to produce a brief funnel cloud over the west mesa.
episodes.174829: A deep east to southeast flow brought ample Gulf of Mexico moisture into the region which combined with a slow moving upper low moving through Arizona.  Heavy rain fell across much of Luna, Grant and western Sierra counties with rainfall totals up to about four and a half inches.
episodes.174864: The combination of tropical moisture and a stalled cold front allowed for scattered showers and thunderstorms across southern Florida throughout the day. Heavier showers began as early as the morning hours bringing rain to areas across Miami-Dade County.
episodes.175395: A moist tropical airmass pushed over Lee County bringing heavy rain and street flooding.

events.narrative: A social media post on Facebook showed a well-defined funnel cloud over the west mesa near Belen, NM on October 8, 2022. Time and location are estimated from the Facebook post.
Several rainfall reports of over 4 inches around the Silver City area with the Gila area receiving 2-2.5 inches.

Heavy rain fell across much of Luna county with the highest amount being 3.04 inches 8.6 miles southeast of Deming.  Other reports included 2.89 inches 15.5 miles west-southwest of Deming and 2.21 inches 16 miles east-southeast of Deming.
An observer reported 2.99 inches in Kingston and another report in Hillsboro of 2.15 inches.

A video post on social media showed notable street flooding in Doral. The roadway near the intersection of NW 87th Ave and NW 74th Street had an estimated six inches of water across the road. Rainfall measurements in the general area were in the 3-4 inch range.
Skywarn spotter reported flooded roadway at intersection of College Parkway and Winkler  Road.
